notes.title: Bugfix for graffiti when reentering the game from the menu
notes.notes: Bugfix for graffiti no longer working when you exited to the menu after having graffitied and then entered the game again without fully quitting the game.

notes.title: Patch for issue preventing some players from playing the game
notes.notes: A patch for an issue preventing some players from playing the game who had their computer language not set to English.
